comparison.objective: Remove a named cartridge fuse from spring clips with an insulated tong puller and place it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Grip the correct fuse with a tool and rock its two ends out sequentially without disturbing neighbors.
comparison.success_condition: The target fuse leaves both clips while held by the puller and rests in the tray; neighbor movement zeros the trial.
comparison.reason: Tool use is shared only generically; sequential levering and extraction from clips differ from two-tool screw/nut countertorque and setting preservation.
